tspan.tspan: The order arrives by email, fax or PDF.
Customer, items and quantities are read automatically. Che
ck the content and the unit prices (matched against the pric
e list).
One order line is created per row, and its number and amou
nt are fixed.
Split into what can come from stock (from stock) and what
must be made (manufacture). For manufacture, lay out the s
teps and choose the material.
The purchase order is approved, then sent to the supplier.
The material that arrived goes into material stock.
On approval, the material for manufacture is reserved.
On the floor tablet, start and complete each step and record
quantities and defects. When every step is done, the finish
ed goods go into product stock.
Confirming creates the delivery note automatically.
Product stock goes down and the order line becomes 出荷
済 (Shipped).
On each customer's closing day, the period's deliveries are
gathered.
An invoice is created from the closing; issue it and send th
e PDF.
Check the payment and set the invoice to 支払済 (Paid).
Export the journal CSV and import it into the accounting soft
ware.

svg.text: From order to payment — the whole flow
